info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Weather Alerts Subscribes-v5-spec
info.description: The Weather Alerts Subscription API allows users to retrieve a list of active subscriptions to severe weather alerts. This endpoint serves as a crucial resource for developers building applications that require timely weather information for their users. Typical consumers include weather service providers and mobile app developers looking to enhance their applications with alert functionalities. By leveraging this API, businesses can ensure their users stay informed about severe weather events relevant to their location.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to subscribe to receive alert notifications. Upon successful subscription, users will begin receiving alerts relevant to their preferences.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to subscribe to alert notifications. It requires a JSON object that contains the necessary parameters to establish the subscription, ensuring the user receives timely updates based on specified criteria.

ListWeatherAlertsSubscribesRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for subscribing to alerts in the application. It should contain the necessary subscription details in string format.

status.description: Indicates whether the subscription was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the subscription request.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the subscription operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the subscription request in milliseconds.

message.description: Informational message regarding the subscription process.

audit.description: Details about the audit information related to the subscription.

ListWeatherAlertsSubscribesResponse_200.description: Schema representing the successful response for the subscription alert operation.

createdBy.description: The user who created the subscription.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the subscription was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the subscription was created automatically.

Audit.description: Schema representing the audit information of the subscription request.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds. This value helps to understand the performance impact of the operation.
